methodology.deterministic: Stored active counts, normalized exact text, answer repetition, legacy fact groups, source presence, format counts, foreign keys.
methodology.heuristic: First four normalized words with digits masked approximate templates. Era uses one unambiguous explicit 1900–2099 question year; all others unknown. Source entity IDs are legacy IDs, not validated canonical subjects.
methodology.not_measured: Truth/ambiguity, canonical fact/event duplication, perceived similarity, source validity, actual historical-era and primary-entity distribution require editorial verification; missing provenance is not proof that a fact is false. External media URLs are not fetched by this audit.

schema.categories:
CREATE TABLE categories (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
    icon TEXT NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)
schema.questions:
CREATE TABLE questions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id),
    difficulty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (difficulty IN (200, 400, 600)),
    question_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (question_type IN ('flag', 'text', 'career', 'spot_diff')),
    question_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    flag_code TEXT NULL,
    media_url_a TEXT NULL,
    media_url_b TEXT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NULL,
    answer_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    tolerance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'مطابق تماماً',
    explanation TEXT NULL,
    source_name TEXT NULL,
    source_url TEXT NULL,
    source_checked_at TEXT NULL,
    content_origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (content_origin IN ('curated', 'api_sourced', 'generated_puzzle')),
    fingerprint TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    is_reserved_backup INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_reserved_backup IN (0, 1)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
, fact_group_id TEXT NULL, source_entity_id TEXT NULL, verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'curated', content_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, times_played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_played_match_id INTEGER NULL, deck_position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, source_license TEXT NULL, source_claim TEXT NULL)
schema.idx_questions_cat_diff_active:
CREATE INDEX idx_questions_cat_diff_active
    ON questions(category_id, difficulty, is_active)
schema.idx_questions_backup:
CREATE INDEX idx_questions_backup
    ON questions(is_reserved_backup, is_active)
schema.question_buckets:
CREATE TABLE question_buckets (
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id),
    difficulty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (difficulty IN (200, 400, 600)),
    cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (cycle >= 1),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (category_id, difficulty)
)
schema.question_usage:
CREATE TABLE question_usage (
    question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id),
    cycle INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cycle >= 1),
    used_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (question_id, cycle)
)
schema.matches:
CREATE TABLE matches (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    match_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    team1_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    team2_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    score_team1 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    score_team2 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    current_turn TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team1' CHECK (current_turn IN ('team1', 'team2')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'abandoned')),
    winner TEXT NULL CHECK (winner IN ('team1', 'team2', 'tie')),
    coin_toss_winner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team1' CHECK (coin_toss_winner IN ('team1', 'team2')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1)
, selected_categories_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', host_token_hash TEXT NULL, host_installation_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES device_installations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, host_user_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT)
schema.match_tiles:
CREATE TABLE match_tiles (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tile_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories(id),
    difficulty INTEGER NULL CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN (200, 400, 600)),
    question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id),
    is_backup INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_backup IN (0, 1)),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unplayed' CHECK (status IN ('unplayed', 'played', 'rerolled')),
    outcome TEXT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('team1', 'team2', 'none')),
    delta_team1 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    delta_team2 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    powers_applied_json TEXT NULL,
    compatible_categories_json TEXT NULL,
    compatible_difficulties_json TEXT NULL,
    answered_at TEXT NULL,
    rerolled_from_question_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES questions(id),
    resolved_request_id TEXT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), allocation_cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, opened_at TEXT NULL, revealed_at TEXT NULL, active_team TEXT NULL, noise_until TEXT NULL,
    UNIQUE(match_id, tile_key),
    CHECK (
        (is_backup = 0 AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND difficulty IS NOT NULL)
        OR (is_backup = 1)
    ),
    CHECK (
        (is_backup = 1 AND compatible_categories_json IS NOT NULL)
        OR (is_backup = 0)
    )
)
schema.idx_match_tiles_board:
CREATE INDEX idx_match_tiles_board
    ON match_tiles(match_id, is_backup, status)
schema.idx_match_tiles_question:
CREATE INDEX idx_match_tiles_question
    ON match_tiles(question_id, status)
schema.idx_match_tiles_bucket:
CREATE INDEX idx_match_tiles_bucket
    ON match_tiles(match_id, category_id, difficulty, is_backup)
schema.idx_match_tiles_request:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_match_tiles_request
    ON match_tiles(match_id, resolved_request_id)
    WHERE resolved_request_id IS NOT NULL
schema.score_adjustments:
CREATE TABLE score_adjustments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    team_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (team_key IN ('team1', 'team2')),
    delta INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (delta IN (-100, 100)),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'تعديل يدوي من المقدم',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    UNIQUE(match_id, request_id)
)
schema.idx_adjustments_match: CREATE INDEX idx_adjustments_match ON score_adjustments(match_id, created_at)
schema.match_events:
CREATE TABLE match_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_key TEXT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)
schema.idx_events_match: CREATE INDEX idx_events_match ON match_events(match_id, id)
schema.idx_events_request:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_events_request
    ON match_events(match_id, request_key)
    WHERE request_key IS NOT NULL
schema.idempotency_keys:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    status_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
    response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (scope, key)
)
schema.seed_runs:
CREATE TABLE seed_runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    seed_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    deterministic_seed INTEGER NOT NULL,
    inserted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    invalid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    network_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'offline',
    report_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)
schema.fact_records:
CREATE TABLE fact_records (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    fact_group_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    fact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_entity_id TEXT NULL,
    source_url TEXT NULL,
    verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'curated',
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), source_license TEXT NULL, source_claim TEXT NULL,
    UNIQUE (fact_group_id, fact_type, source_name)
)
schema.idx_questions_shoe:
CREATE INDEX idx_questions_shoe
    ON questions(category_id, difficulty, is_active, times_played, deck_position)
schema.idx_matches_finished:
CREATE INDEX idx_matches_finished
    ON matches(status, updated_at)
schema.harvester_cursors:
CREATE TABLE harvester_cursors (
    source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
    last_synced_at TEXT NULL,
    total_harvested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    checkpoint_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (source_name, category_slug)
)
schema.sync_jobs:
CREATE TABLE sync_jobs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    job_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_slug TEXT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
        CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'partial', 'failed')),
    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    started_at TEXT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT NULL,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    error TEXT NULL
)
schema.idx_sync_jobs_active:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sync_jobs_active
    ON sync_jobs(source_name, COALESCE(category_slug, ''))
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')
schema.match_powers:
CREATE TABLE match_powers (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    team_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (team_key IN ('team1', 'team2')),
    power_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    pick_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pick_index >= 0 AND pick_index < 6),
    drafted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    used_at TEXT NULL,
    used_tile_key TEXT NULL,
    UNIQUE(match_id, pick_index),
    UNIQUE(match_id, team_key, power_id)
)
schema.idx_match_powers_match:
CREATE INDEX idx_match_powers_match
    ON match_powers(match_id, pick_index)
schema.idx_match_powers_team:
CREATE INDEX idx_match_powers_team
    ON match_powers(match_id, team_key, power_id)
schema.users:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    username TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'named' CHECK (kind IN ('named', 'shadow')),
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
, password_hash TEXT NULL)
schema.device_installations:
CREATE TABLE device_installations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    install_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    credential_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    shadow_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revoked IN (0, 1))
)
schema.match_participants:
CREATE TABLE match_participants (
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    team_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (team_key IN ('team1', 'team2')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (match_id, user_id)
)
schema.idx_participants_user:
CREATE INDEX idx_participants_user
    ON match_participants(user_id, match_id)
schema.user_question_history:
CREATE TABLE user_question_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    match_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (outcome IN ('team1', 'team2', 'none')),
    played_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    UNIQUE(user_id, question_id)
)
schema.idx_history_user:
CREATE INDEX idx_history_user
    ON user_question_history(user_id, question_id)
schema.account_sessions:
CREATE TABLE account_sessions (
    token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
schema.auth_attempts:
CREATE TABLE auth_attempts (
    scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    window_start INTEGER NOT NULL
)
